title: SvgRadialGradient
responsibility: Renders the native radialGradient element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgRadialGradient.attributes
inputs.description: Native radialGradient attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgRadialGradient.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native radialGradient element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgRadialGradient
outputs.description: The actual native radialGradient element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
